about.subtitle: QA Engineer with a background in frontend development and design.
about.intro: I have been doing QA for over five years, with a background in graphic design and frontend development. This lets me connect technical quality with UX and detail — I don't just check functionality, I think about the overall user impact. I specialise in AI-driven testing and LLM testing, where standard methodologies hit their limits.
about.tagline: I look at the product through the eyes of the person on the other side of the screen. That's why I see problems before they happen.
about.tagline.line1: I look at the product through the eyes of the person on the other side of the screen.

experience.vocalls.desc: Manual and automated testing of AI and LLM components for a call center platform, using Playwright and Locust. My work also covers technical documentation, SQL, and load testing.
experience.faktura.desc: End-to-end automated testing of an invoice platform with Cypress across 8 language localizations. Set up visual regression testing with Percy and worked with CircleCI pipelines.
experience.iguana.desc: QA across client projects including Campiri and Dokempu, using Playwright and API testing integrated with GitLab CI/CD. Managed test cycles and defect tracking in Jira.
experience.motionlab.desc: Web development for a video production platform using Next.js and TypeScript. Also built an Adobe After Effects extension in ExtendScript, deployed via GitHub Actions.
experience.matchhype.desc: Frontend development for the Matchhype.com gaming platform — React, MUI, REST API, and Auth0 integration. Worked on a fast-moving product in an agile environment.
experience.alfa.desc: Frontend development with React, TypeScript, Vite, and Firebase — including the HyperProstor AI chatbot platform and a custom UI component library built with Styled Components.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a0: I understand the product from multiple angles: as a developer, tester, and user. That's how I find problems before they surface and help improve product quality as a whole.
faq.a1: I work with a modern stack: Playwright, Cypress, React, Next.js. But the approach matters more than the tools. I focus on real user behaviour and the quality of the product as a whole. Full overview in the
faq.a2: I work on projects both short-term and long-term. If you're dealing with product quality or AI features, we can get started quickly and without unnecessary overhead.
faq.a3: Primarily remote, in-person meetings as needed (e.g. sprint, kickoff).
faq.a4: I understand code as a developer and think like a tester. That's how I find problems earlier and help improve product quality as a whole.
now.title: What I'm doing now
now.work.desc: I'm working as a contractor at Vocalls/Callminer, testing AI and LLM components. My focus is on the quality of systems that actually talk to people — making sure they hold up in the real world.
now.learning.desc: Diving deeper into AI tool orchestration — OpenClaw, RelayPlane, Playwright. I'm exploring how to connect testing with automation, and how prompt design shapes AI behavior in production.
now.reading.desc: AI testing methodologies, prompt engineering for QA, and what it means to be a tester when AI is writing — and testing — the code.
